name: Koya-Ryujin Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of the Koyasan holy mountain and the Ryujin cedar forests of Nara and Wakayama, with the pilgrimage trails of the sacred Kii range.
notes: Managed by Wakayama/Nara. Koyasan's temple stay and the Ryujin-mura cedar valleys are the draws.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
businessHours: Open access (park; facility hours vary by season and area)
